simple.summary: אֶשְׁפָּר (ʼeshpâr) means a measured portion First listed occurrence: 1Chr 16 3.

definitions.full: H829. eshpar אֶשְׁמָּר 2Sam 6:19 = 1Chr 16:3 ; ᵐ5 2Sam 6:19 Aq Symm. cake or roll ; other Verss. ancient & modern have various conjectures, but actual etymology & meaning unknown; see Lag GGA 1884, No. 7. 262 = M i. 214 Dr Sm . אַשְׁמַּתּוֺת אַשְׁמֹּת, see שׁפת .
